pages.title: How to print output
pages.content:
Cool - so you learnt how to accept integer inputs.

Now let's look at how to convert input into output and display the same.

Most algorithmic programming problems will need you to generate the following types of output
- Integers or Floats
- Strings
- An array of integers or strings

Go ahead and try in the IDE.\
Click on **Submit** to proceed.

callout.title: Engineering Principle
callout.text: Understanding How to print output in Input and Output is vital for architectural correctness and optimal performance.

codeCard.code: using System; class Program { static void Main() { Console.WriteLine("Hello, SEED-IT!"); } }

checkpoint.question: What does Console.WriteLine do in a programming solution?
options: It writes a value followed by a newline
It reads an integer from input
checkpoint.explanation: Console.WriteLine sends the supplied value to standard output and moves to the next line.
